tip20MemoOnFund.event: TransferWithMemo(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount, bytes32 indexed memo)
tip20MemoOnFund.note: memo is bytes32(jobId): the stablecoin transfer itself carries the reconciliation key, no log-join required

tempoFeatures.feeToken: transactions paid in AlphaUSD (TIP-20), not a volatile gas token

batchedCalls.note: createJob + fund in a single Tempo transaction (type 0x76, calls array of length 2). The job id cannot come from createJob's return value inside a batch, so the client reads nextJobId() first and passes it to fund; the emitted JobCreated id matched the prediction.

notes: Tempo contract creation is priced far above vanilla EVM: ~11.0M gas for this 13,090-byte runtime (~800 gas/byte + ~0.5M fixed) vs the 200 gas/byte EVM default.
forge script cannot deploy this: it ignores --gas-limit and broadcasts with its own estimate (2,845,784), which reverts out of gas. Use scripts/deploy-escrow.sh (forge create --gas-limit 20000000).

Failed attempts (left as evidence in the record, none of which created code): forge script 0x57546be5 (gas 2845784), forge script 0x947a0739 (gas 2845784), forge create 0xabcf76c8 (gas 6000000), cast send nonce-3 (gas 3000000).
Live smoke test consumed job id 1: approve + createJob + fund executed on-chain, escrow holds 50.000000 AlphaUSD, job state Funded.
Explorer host matters: https://explore.tempo.xyz/tx/<hash> returns 404 for Moderato transactions; https://explore.testnet.tempo.xyz/tx/<hash> resolves (verified against the deploy tx).
